allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Name, Length; Write-Output "---FLUTTER---"; \(Get-Command flutter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; Write-Output "---DART---"; \(Get-Command dart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source)
PowerShell(flutter pub get 2>&1 | Out-Null; Write-Output "ExitCode: $LASTEXITCODE"; Test-Path "pubspec.lock")
PowerShell(git --version; Write-Output "---GH---"; \(Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; gh auth status 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 6)

PowerShell(git config --global user.name; git config --global user.email; Write-Output "---HELPER---"; git config --global credential.helper; Write-Output "---GCM---"; \(Get-Command git-credential-manager -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source)
